I couldn't create the Settings canvas. Nothing in `.design/` changed.

**What blocked it:** a new canvas has to be made by the studio's own create step. That runs through `maude design curl-local`, and that command needs your approval. This session can't show an approval prompt, so it was refused automatically. Writing the canvas file by hand isn't allowed, so I stopped there.

**What I did instead:** I wrote the full design as a draft, ready to drop in. It has four 1440 × 1024 desktop artboards in the maude design system, dark theme, built from its standard classes (panels, buttons, inputs, segmented controls, switches, checkboxes, callouts):
- **General:** theme (Dark / Light / System), language, snap to grid, dot grid, default zoom, what opens on launch, design system for new canvases.
- **Account:** profile name and email, connected services (Claude, GitHub, Figma), sign out, and delete account as a red danger action.
- **Notifications:** a grid of five events against In app / Email / Desktop, plus email digest and quiet hours.
- **Privacy:** who sees you on a canvas, cursor sharing, opt-in "Search in pictures" (off by default), usage data, crash reports and data export.
